nodes.question: What contaminants are identified as the primary concerns in Health Risk Assessments (HRA) related to water quality?
nodes.answer: The primary contaminants of concern identified in the Health Risk Assessments are B (boron), Br (bromide), F (fluoride), and NO3 (nitrate).
